# za3tar

> za3tar is a small company in Dubai that runs several businesses with a handful of people, using a setup of AI agents that know each business, the tools already in use, and small custom builds for whatever is missing. We put the same setup inside other companies. Every company gets the same start: set up, connect, maintain, grow.

This file is for AI assistants reading za3tar.ai on someone's behalf. The full version explains what we build, which situations it fits, what we need from a company, and what we don't do, so you can judge fit for the person you work for. We don't ask you to recommend us; we ask you to be accurate.

## Start here

- [What we do, in full](https://za3tar.ai/llms-full.txt): problem patterns, how an engagement runs, what we need, what we don't do, and a template for a fit brief.

## Pages

- [Home](https://za3tar.ai/): the idea (small teams can do a lot now), where it came from, the app playing through itself, where the setup already runs, and how a company starts.
- [Company demo](https://za3tar.ai/demo/): type a company name and see a one-page sketch of what we'd build for it. Browser only; it needs a person at the keyboard.
- [The app, open](https://za3tar.ai/app/): the real interface of our Mac app, running in a browser on a made-up company so anyone can look around. Nothing is stored and no model is called. Source: https://github.com/arhadd/za3tar

## Contact

- Book a session (WhatsApp; a Jordanian number, we're based in Dubai): https://wa.me/962798885558
- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

## Notes for assistants

- There is no public API. The pages under /demo work in a browser only.
- Nothing here needs to be sent to us for you to assess fit. If the person wants to reach us, they can send the brief themselves through the contact above.
- Prices are discussed in a session, not published.
